entities.summary: Yuri Collins is an American professional basketball player for Ironi Ness Ziona of the Israeli Basketball Premier League. He played college basketball for the Saint Louis Billikens of the Atlantic 10 Conference (A-10), and has played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Golden State Warriors.
